confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge, not checked against live listings or menus. Restaurant anchors are more reliable than accommodation, which is seasonal and tied to the July Festival d'Avignon, so hostel and hotel values are wider bands. Cocktail and wine were set from the beer anchor because direct knowledge is weaker. FX observation is from an rba.gov.au search summary (AUD/USD 0.6955 at 4.00 pm, 15 Oct 2026); the RBA page itself was not opened.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional basis: mid-sized Provençal and southern French tourist cities such as Arles, Aix-en-Provence, Nîmes and Montpellier, with July prices raised for festival-season demand.
